```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z ERROR allocator.cc:456 CUDA illegal memory access
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z FATAL runtime.cc:89 aborting due to GPU error
```
carol (ml-runtime): Also saw KV cache corruption trace in logs. Could be a misaligned pointer from recent loader patch
dan (sre): Cordon and drain node gpu-serving-prod-12? rolling restart for that node will help. any customer impact yet?

alice (on-call): Taking node. cordon/drain in progress: `kubectl cordon gpu-serving-prod-12 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpu-serving-prod-12`

```
for i in $(seq 1 5000); do ./infer --model gated-2 --seq 2048 || echo "fail $i"; done
```

`NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:04:00): 79, PID=12345, GPU has fallen off the bus`
alice (on-call): Escalating to infra team /kernel: @infra-bot please open kernel vendor ticket + collect kmem and vmcore

carol (ml-runtime): Hypothesis: race in loader's pinned-buffer mapping + eviction during batching. This shows up under high-concurrency long sequence workloads

- capture coredump + gpu memory map
- vendor ticket + kernel tracing (perf, ftrace)
- rollback loader patch on next stable deploy
